decisions.reason: As a flagship move close to the core business, offshore vessel management preserves strategic upside in offshore and renewable maritime markets while using capabilities the firm already has.
Crew and corporate travel management is a low-cost adjacent service with clear cross-selling potential and little sign that its value has been disproven.
The online vessel information portal is a strategic digital extension and flagship that can deepen customer relationships, so its option value likely still exceeds its carrying cost.

The mobile vessel performance app is a less central digital offering with ongoing maintenance demands and likely overlap with the portal, making redeployment of resources more attractive if traction is uncertain.
